differences.what: massing: the draft's 23 x 5.5 m box with a generic corner turret is now the sheet's '2½B' front block, 12.82 x 7.27 m, its rock-faced ashlar front standing flush with 2009's and the '2B' rear block behind it; the front's north edge prints at x 1150 px against the photograph's 1145

the round-arched entrance at the north end: the render's ring x 1180-1335 px, its crown y 1245, the threshold y 1545, against the photograph's arch x 1185-1335, crown about y 1240 and threshold y 1550
the cross window over the door: two lights on a mullion under a transom, x 1195-1320 px, y 860-1000, as the photograph's (its glazing bars render as the K06 pair's)

the round turret: its outline from about x 1375 px, its tall ground-storey lights (sill y 1440, head y 1215), the near second-storey light at its north edge and the band of small square lights round a short top stage standing on the front's head course, all within about 25 px (0.3 m) of the photograph's

the turret's roof: the photograph shows it in two stages, a flared slate skirt from the turret's eave (y 590 px) to a ledge at about y 480, and a narrower, steeper faceted cone over it to the apex (x 1445, y 385); K08 builds a tower one plain cone, so the render's single cone is the wrong shape. T-3616 (the next piece of T-1915) builds the two stages

the gabled dormer on the street slope over the door: its apex within about 15 px (0.15 m) of the photograph's, about 2 m across; the photograph's dormer is a deep gabled hood over a recessed light with a lantern hung in it, which the render draws as a plain dormer face with one sash

the roof's height at the party line with 2009: the photograph's slate rises to about y 395-430 px beside 2009's gable; the render's street slope and coped party parapet reach about y 445-450 (about 0.3 m lower)
the rear stack: the photograph's stack stands right of the cone's apex (x 1510-1555, y 390-460 px); the render's stack at u 8.0 m stands behind the cone from this camera
the stone's tone: the print is monochrome; the render's pale Lemont limestone is the record's reconstruction
the north party wall: the render, drawn without 2009 Prairie, shows 2011's north wall in common brick where the photograph shows 2009's front

the stoop and the yard: the photograph hides the flight behind 2009's cheek wall and shows the yard strewn with cut stone and planks (building work); the render's straight stoop and coped wall are the record's reconstruction

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
